title: Bound delayed closing measurement so a predecessor retry cannot move a later turn's edit into its successor's report
outcome: Determine and prevent incorrect turn attribution when an immediate predecessor's delayed delivery postpones its successor's closing source measurement.
acceptance: A deterministic three-turn worker test gates predecessor A's delivery while B closes unchanged, then starts and edits C before releasing A, and records B and C's actual closing measurements and reports without assuming the outcome.

The resulting behavior preserves the real change and exact source timestamps and ownership; a change made by C is not asserted to be B's change, with no fabricated baseline or receipt, weakened post-check protection, new manual ordering, or blocked ordinary provider turn.
The chosen correction or explicit supported limit is documented and reviewed, with focused positive and real-change negative evidence on the exact candidate.
